area: Stoat Slingshot AI (StoatSlingConfig_Slingshot, SlingshotController nose row)
summary: Stoat run1, trained in the real game with time_ai_search.py, replaced the 2026-11-08 sling rows (warp press from 11.5 u instead of 310, hold window 59 deg instead of 120) and the nose pair (2.62 at 10.43/s instead of 2.5 at the fleet lag); every Slingshot rung 18-40% faster on 32 fresh flights a side. The same nose pair goes into Stoat_Regatta. promote_trained_drives.py --revert StoatSlingConfig_Slingshot puts the sling rows back.
